core_obligations: Pick the first stratum leaving U and an affine piece V with image not in U
Verify the distinguished square via the isomorphism over the boundary
Repair density by refining V with a dense affine from the Noetherian complement

proof_roadmap.step: Pick the first stratum leaving U and an affine piece V with image not in U

difficulty_reason: Use the Noetherian stratification lemma to get U_p ⊂ X and etale V_p -> U_p; pick the first stratum not inside U and an affine open V ⊂ V_p whose image leaves U; then W = U ∪ Im(V) with the reduced boundary Z gives f^{-1}Z -> Z an isomorphism (property of the stratification), so (U ⊂ W, V -> W) is a distinguished square; if the intersection image is not dense, replace the missing closed part U' (Noetherian) by a dense open subscheme U'' (quasi-separated open contains dense scheme) and a dense affine U''' inside it, and replace f by V amalga U''' -> X.
